assessment: We agree that this study, especially when considered in parallel with the work from Belyy et al., significantly furthers our understanding of how early events in the unfolded protein response pathway trigger downstream signals. This pathway is essential to respond and protect against potentially toxic insults to ER homeostasis. On a more general note, the advances in single-molecule optical imaging, which were developed for your work, will benefit others who wish to probe dynamic signaling events at the ER membrane and beyond.
